name: AI Recruiter Assistant
subtitle: Chatbot built into this portfolio
bullets: **Problem:** recruiters skim portfolios and rarely find the specific answer they need.

**Approach:** LLM chatbot (Gemini via a serverless worker) grounded on this portfolio's own data, so answers on experience, skills, certifications and availability stay accurate and consistent with the CV.

name: TradeExpert
subtitle: Multi-Agent Stock Analysis Assistant
bullets: **Problem:** researching and screening stocks means juggling many sources and manual analysis.

**Approach:** multi-agent assistant in Python on **Google ADK**, with specialised agents for screening, company research, financial analysis and trend evaluation; runs on Gemini, Ollama or LM Studio models and pulls market data from Yahoo Finance.

name: AI Code Reviewer Bot
bullets: **Problem:** code reviews are slow and inconsistent for small changes.
**Approach:** Python bot that analyzes code changes and generates automated review feedback.

name: AI-Text-Assistant
subtitle: Privacy-First Local AI Assistant
bullets: **Problem:** cloud AI writing tools send private text to third-party APIs.
**Approach:** React + Node.js app on **Ollama** for fully local LLM inference with no external API calls, covering summarization, rewriting, grammar correction and content generation.

name: Multi-Agent Content Pipeline
subtitle: Research → Verify → Generate
bullets: **Problem:** technical content takes hours of manual research, fact-checking and editing before it is publishable.

**Approach:** containerized AI microservice and web app that automates end-to-end technical research, editorial fact-checking, content synthesis and AI image generation, using specialised **CrewAI** agents for each stage (research → verify → generate).

name: Homelab Infrastructure Setup
bullets: Built and maintained a Proxmox-based homelab with Docker and Linux containers.
Deployed self-hosted apps (AdGuardHome, Traefik, n8n, Portainer) with reverse proxy and SSL.
Designed private subnet architecture with NAT, DHCP, DNS filtering, port forwarding and LAN segmentation.
